claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 uses independent logistic classifiers instead of softmax for multilabel class prediction.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We do not use a softmax as we have found it is unnecessary for good performance, instead we simply use independent logistic classifiers.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 predicts boxes at three different scales using a concept similar to feature pyramid networks.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLOv3 predicts boxes at 3 different scales. Our system extracts features from those scales using a similar concept to feature pyramid networks

claims.claim_text_normalized: The Darknet-53 backbone performs on par with state-of-the-art classifiers while using fewer floating point operations.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Thus Darknet-53 performs on par with state-of-the-art classifiers but with fewer floating point operations and more speed.

claims.claim_text_normalized: At 320 by 320 resolution YOLOv3 is as accurate as SSD but three times faster.
claims.evidence_quote_short: At 320 × 320 YOLOv3 runs in 22 ms at 28.2 mAP , as accurate as SSD but three times faster .

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 achieves 57.9 AP50 in 51 ms on a Titan X, comparable to RetinaNet but 3.8 times faster.
claims.evidence_quote_short: It achieves 57.9 AP50 in 51 ms on a Titan X, compared to 57.5 AP50 in 198 ms by RetinaNet, similar performance but 3.8 × faster .

claims.claim_text_normalized: With multi-scale predictions YOLOv3 achieves relatively high performance on small objects.
claims.evidence_quote_short: With the new multi-scale predictions we see YOLOv3 has relatively high APS performance.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 performance drops significantly as the IOU threshold increases.
claims.evidence_quote_short: However, performance drops significantly as the IOU threshold increases indicating YOLOv3 struggles to get the boxes perfectly aligned with the object.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using focal loss dropped YOLOv3's mAP by approximately two points.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We tried using focal loss. It dropped our mAP about 2 points.
